requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
description:
I`ve created a few food items specifically for you. Here are the object categories:
* Burger`s box
* Canned food
* Cereals
* Chocolate
* Coffee (various versions)
* Cookies (Oreo and others)
* Milk bottles
* Instant noodles (cups and box/bag)
* Pasta
* Pizza box
* Sauce bottles
* Tea box

Everything is designed in a **low poly** style to save resources and reflect aesthetic of old-fashioned PS1/PS2 games.
changes: Selected source groups, bottom-center pivots; shared original geometry/UV/textures. PSX OBJ converted in Blender; missing image paths repaired.
